scope: Saved-output numerical and native-identity checks for four exact-guide branch controls; no new solver runs
limitations: Supplied first-arrival seeds use known x-only references and are not a general 3D initialization method.
Reference time ordering is floating point; complete candidate enumeration is distinct from interval-certified time ranking.
No-resampling copy changes only initialization; every interior node remains free during optimization.
Fixed-polygon source derivatives are not optimized-travel-time derivatives unless path stationarity and branch differentiability hold.
Raw sampled-polygon stages have no solver convergence claim; numerical flags remain unchanged elsewhere.
The exact-circle/guide reference is continuous; its chordal samples have a separate polygon discretization error.
The C++ strict_interface_crossings field counts all x grid planes; review exact_velocity_kink_nodes counts only changes of velocity slope at x0,1,5,6km.
The one-sided coupled perturbation tests one direction and does not prove full nonsmooth stationarity.
Retaining knots only at initialization does not constrain their subsequent locations and is not a convergence repair.
